summary: Iteration 3: E2E testing of new features - watchlist strip, volume pane, and scenario scripts. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_ticker_scenarios.py (ticker REST + drift, scenarios REST full lifecycle, WS ticker sub/unsub, WS run_scenario/cancel_scenario with subscribed msg 'scenario' field). Frontend: All 8 requested scenarios pass against production URL — watchlist renders 8 items with per-symbol change badges and switches market on click; candle chart has 11 canvases confirming 2 panes with volume histogram; scenario builder loads flash_crash preset (5 rows), remove -> 4 rows, add -> 5 rows, Run -> scenario-running shows 'Flash Crash step X/5', progress advances (0/5 -> 2/5 within 4s), cancel removes it; toast 'ETH-USD volatility -> NORMAL' visible; no console errors, no runtime error overlays.

test_results.GET /api/ticker: PASS - type=ticker, 8 markets, all fields present, numeric change_1m_pct
test_results.ticker drift (idle markets): PASS - 3s apart shows multiple mids changed via market_clock
test_results.GET /api/scenarios: PASS - 4 preset ids present, running dict
test_results.POST flash_crash + status + delete lifec: PASS - 202, name='Flash Crash', total=5; second DELETE -> cancelled false
test_results.Validation errors: PASS - unknown preset 400, missing mode 400, magnitude 60 -> 422, unknown symbol -> 404
test_results.WS subscribe_ticker/unsubscribe_ticker: PASS - ticker_subscribed then multiple ticker msgs, stops after unsubscribe
test_results.WS run/cancel calm_drift: PASS - subscribed msg has 'scenario' field, scenario_accepted, scenario_started (Calm Drift, total=2), volatility_changed calm, scenario_step 1/2, cancel reply cancelled=true, scenario_cancelled event, invalid steps -> error
test_results.FE watchlist: PASS - 8 items, active data-active=true, click ETH-USD switches header to ~3474 and terminal to ETH-USD
test_results.FE volume pane: PASS - candle-chart has 11 canvases (chart + volume pane), 'Volume' label present, interval 5s toggle keeps both panes rendering
test_results.FE scenario builder: PASS - preset select loads flash_crash 5 rows, remove -> 4, add step -> 5, Run -> scenario-running 'Flash Crash step 0/5' -> '2/5' after 4s, Cancel removes it; volatility-normal-btn resets

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L482: _resolve_scenario re-runs ScenarioStep(**s) for preset steps unnecessarily (they're already validated dicts). Minor perf/clarity nit.

server.py L732: ticker_stream captures reply closure but ticker_task variable is set AFTER create_task. Non-issue currently but if code is later refactored to check ticker_task inside coroutine, could race. Cosmetic.
ScenarioBuilder.js: presets fetched via axios only once on mount; a WS reconnection or backend restart won't refresh preset list. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
Watchlist volatility label uses uppercase text but color #FB923C on dark bg has adequate contrast; OK.
seed_data_creation: None. Reset ETH-USD, BTC-USD, SOL-USD, AVAX-USD volatility to normal after tests.
